model: Insurer FCFE at cost of equity on net result, net debt held at zero (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity and EPS CAGRs diverge by far more than 30% and both are distorted: (1) IFRS 4 -> IFRS 17/9 break at FY2022/FY2023 -- FY2022 IFRS 4 equity EUR 21.2bn was depressed by unrealised bond losses, inflating the 3yr equity CAGR to 16.4%; (2) the 5yr EPS CAGR of 40.5% starts from the COVID-hit FY2020 (EUR 8.63). Revenue 3yr uses FY2022 IFRS 17 restated insurance revenue (55,385); 5yr mixes IFRS 4 GWP (FY2020) with IFRS 17 insurance revenue (FY2025) and is not like-for-like. EPS 3yr uses FY2022 restated net income 5,309 / 139.3m shares = EUR 38.1. Selected rate is the BVPS CAGR, which reflects per-share book compounding after an ~85% total payout.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are null by design: insurer OCF is dominated by reserve movements and is not an owner-FCF series. Per-share growth exceeds aggregate growth by ~2.5-3%/yr of buy-back accretion.

scenario_narratives.base: Guidance-plus FY2026 (EUR 6.6bn) on a benign H1 cat year, then two flat-to-down years as P&C reinsurance pricing softens, offset by mix-shift and investment income; 85% payout, 9% cost of equity, 3% terminal growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: Discipline in a shallow soft market plus L&H/GSI/ERGO growth and a rising reinvestment yield sustain 4-5% aggregate growth (EPS >8% with buy-backs); 87% payout, 8.5% cost of equity.
scenario_narratives.bear: Heavy H2 2026 cats, a deeper soft market and reserve or FX hits cut FY2027 earnings ~12%; payout at the 80% floor, 10% cost of equity, 2% terminal growth.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Munich Re is valued on what it pays its owners: dividends plus buy-backs, which Ambition 2030 commits at >80% of the net result. That stream is discounted at a EUR cost of equity with debt held at zero because subordinated debt is already charged in the net result. Book-value x justified P/B is the cross-check (~EUR 667 at 18% RoE). At roughly 11x guided earnings the market is pricing a deeper or longer earnings decline from the soft reinsurance cycle than the base case assumes.
key_risks_to_valuation: P&C reinsurance pricing softening faster than mix-shift can offset (renewal volumes already down double digits at several 2026 dates)
Nat-cat severity/frequency: a single USD 100bn+ industry event can consume a year's major-loss budget and more
US casualty reserve adequacy (social inflation) and L&H reserve assumptions
Cost of equity: each 50bp on the 9% base moves value materially because ~85% of earnings are distributed
Execution of Ambition 2030 under a new CEO (Jurecka since end-2025)

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 437.4-572.6
data_sources.financials: MUV2.DE_Metrics.csv (core_metrics + kpis FY2011-H1 FY2026); H1 2026 half-year report (shares in circulation line 2125, equity, NCI, guidance line 730); FY2025 annual report (dividend EUR 24.00 line 1244)
data_sources.qualitative: MUV2.DE_Analysis.json: Ambition 2030 targets (RoE >18%, EPS CAGR >8%, payout >80%, Solvency II >200%), FY2026 guidance EUR 6.3bn, EUR 2.25bn buy-back, 2026 renewal volumes, ratings actions

inputs.base_revenue_note: NOT revenue. FY2025 IFRS 17 net result EUR 6,118m (Metrics.csv FY2025 NetIncome; record, vs EUR 6.0bn target). The engine compounds this aggregate net-result stream; insurance revenue (EUR 60.4bn FY2025, ~EUR 64bn guided FY2026) is not a cash-generating base for an insurer and is not used. Interest revenue (EUR 6.1bn) is core investment income and is already inside the net result.
inputs.share_count_basis: 125,814,467 shares in circulation at 30 June 2026 (H1 2026 half-year report line 2125; 1,155,652 treasury shares excluded). No dilutive instruments of note. Held FLAT because buy-backs are counted inside the distribution stream (dividend + buy-back); shrinking the count as well would double-count the buy-back.
inputs.net_debt_treatment: Held at ZERO, the insurers convention in this folder (ALV.DE, LGEN.L, PRU, GL, IAG.AX). Debt is EUR 7.4bn of subordinated (Tier 2/hybrid) liabilities at H1 2026, whose coupon is charged inside the net result; cash EUR 5.8bn is operating liquidity of a EUR 285bn balance sheet backing technical provisions. Subtracting debt after discounting a post-interest equity flow would deduct it twice.
inputs.last_fcf_note: Distributable FCFE: FY2025 dividend EUR 24.00/share paid April 2026 (EUR 3,047m, H1 2026 cash flow) + EUR 2.25bn buy-back programme (Apr 2026-Apr 2027) = EUR 5,297m, 86.6% of FY2025 net result. Insurer OCF-less-capex (EUR 4,606m FY2025; -EUR 7.6bn FY2022) swings with claims reserves and is retained as reported_fcf for audit only; the identity last_fcf = reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income deliberately does not hold.
inputs.sbc_source: Metrics.csv EquityAwardTaxes 0 FY2023-25; Munich Re remunerates via cash-settled long-term incentives expensed in the net result, no material equity-settled scheme. SBC-zero: house and street coincide, band_position null.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 cash buy-backs EUR 1,878m; H1 2026 EUR 1,063m under the EUR 2.25bn programme to the April 2027 AGM, shares cancelled. Count 139.3m (FY2022) -> 125.8m (H1 2026), ~-2.5%/yr.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T15:39:30Z XETRA regular close (Friday); latest regular-session print, not after-hours
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of EQUITY in EUR, not WACC: 10y Bund ~2.7% + beta ~1.0 x 6.0% ERP = ~8.7%, rounded to 9.0% base. Set 50bp above ALV.DE (8.5%) because a reinsurer's earnings carry a fatter nat-cat and pricing-cycle tail than a diversified primary insurer, even though Munich Re's measured equity beta is below 1. Bull 8.5% (Aa2 Moody's upgrade June 2026, ~300% Solvency II, rising stable-earnings share); bear 10.0% (cat/reserve shock plus soft-market de-rating).
inputs.lease_treatment: Not applicable: lease costs sit inside the net result; no separate lease adjustment on an equity flow.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is immaterial (EUR 166m of EUR 33.7bn equity at H1 2026; NCI share of net result EUR 3m H1 2026). The net result used is effectively attributable to shareholders.
inputs.notes: MODEL: insurer/reinsurer -> FCFE at cost of equity through the component engine with net debt held at zero, matching the house precedent for insurers and specifically the sibling German composite ALV.DE so the two are comparable. The routing table's BVPS-compounding x exit P/B is used as the CROSS-CHECK rather than the primary because Munich Re pays out >80% of earnings (Ambition 2030 pledge) so book barely compounds (equity EUR 30.0bn FY2020 -> 33.4bn FY2025, with an IFRS 4->17 break at FY2022/23); value sits in the distribution stream. ENGINE MAPPING: base_revenue = aggregate net result; ebitda_margin_path = total payout ratio (dividend + buy-back as % of net result); SBC, D&A, capex, cash tax, lease and working capital all zero because the net result is already post-tax, post-interest and post-everything. Flow = distributions to shareholders, discounted at cost of equity, net_debt = 0. CROSS-CHECK: BVPS H1 2026 = (33,727 - 166) / 125.81 = EUR 266.8; sustainable RoE 18% (Ambition 2030 >18%; FY2025 18.3%; H1 2026 annualised 23% on a benign cat half) -> justified P/B (RoE - g)/(CoE - g) = (18 - 3)/(9 - 3) = 2.5x -> ~EUR 667, vs market P/B ~2.1x. FY2026 guidance EUR 6.3bn net result reiterated at H1 2026 (half-year report line 730). Q3 2026 results not yet released at valuation date (due early November).

bear.growth_rates_rationale: FY2026 lands at the EUR 6.3bn guide only because a heavy H2 hurricane season eats the H1 surplus. FY2027 -12% to ~EUR 5.5bn: a soft market (P&C reinsurance combined ratio back above 85%) coincides with a second above-budget cat year or US casualty reserve strengthening, and USD weakness (FY2025 currency result -EUR 1.4bn) persists. Recovery to 2-3% only.
bear.narrative: Cycle turns hard against reinsurers: RoE reverts to ~12-14%, payout held at the 80% floor, market re-rates to a higher cost of equity.

base.growth_rates_rationale: Aggregate net-result growth (not EPS; buy-back accretion is in the distribution stream). FY2026 EUR 6.6bn: H1 EUR 3.9bn on a 4.2% major-loss ratio vs an 18% budget, plus an H2 of ~EUR 2.7bn assuming the full major-loss budget (H2 FY2025 was EUR 2.9bn) -> beats the EUR 6.3bn guide, as Munich Re has for five straight years. FY2027-28 flat-to-down: P&C reinsurance is softening (1 Jan 2026 renewal volume -7.8%, prices falling at April/July) and FY2026's benign cat year will not repeat; partly offset by reinvestment yield ~4.3% above book yield and EUR 200m cost saves. Then 3-4%, fading to 3%: 15% retention x 18-20% RoE = 2.7-3.0% self-funded growth.
base.ebitda_margin_path_rationale: Total payout ratio. Ambition 2030 pledges >80% (dividend + buy-back / net result); FY2025 actual 86.6% (EUR 3.05bn dividend + EUR 2.25bn buy-back). Base 85%, consistent with 3% terminal growth at a 20% RoE.
base.narrative: Munich Re delivers roughly its guidance path through a soft P&C reinsurance market, holds RoE near 18-20% on mix-shift to L&H, GSI and ERGO, and keeps returning ~85% of earnings.

bull.growth_rates_rationale: FY2026 EUR 6.8bn (quiet H2 cat season on top of the strong H1). Softening is shallow because Munich Re walks away from underpriced volume, and the investment-yield tailwind plus GSI/L&H growth carry aggregate growth of 4-5%, i.e. EPS near the top of the >8% Ambition 2030 CAGR once buy-backs are added.
bull.narrative: Ambition 2030 overdelivered: RoE sustained above 20%, stable earnings share reaches 60%, payout 87%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 17x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25, matching ALV.DE. No solvency tail (~300% Solvency II vs a 200% floor, Aa2/AA- ratings) argues against a heavier bear weight; but a reinsurer entering a softening P&C cycle with fat-tailed cat exposure argues against tilting to bull after a 52-week run toward the top of the range.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
